Hi Alex / Priya

following up with more concrete options and examples. TL;DR: we support both patterns; for production we recommend service accounts + short-lived tokens. API keys are OK for initial POCs.

Option A

Service accounts + short-lived JWT (recommended for production):
- Flow: create a Redwood service account (via Console/API) -> mint a signed JWT assertion from your IDP -> exchange with Redwood STS endpoint -> receive short-lived access token (expires e.g., 15m/1h).
- Benefits: per-service-account RBAC, no long-lived secrets in code, easy rotation via your IdP/KMS, audit logs per-token.
- Example exchange (curl):

  # exchange signed JWT for short-lived token
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/token/exchange \n    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n    -d '{"grant_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer", "assertion": "<SIGNED_JWT>", "scope": "generation embeddings" }' | jq -r '.access_token'

- Sample call to generation endpoint with token:

  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","input":"Summarize..."}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate

Option B

API keys (fast to start, less secure):
- Issue scoped API keys from the Console; recommended to restrict by route, project, and CIDR, and set an expiry.
- Rotation: rotate keys on a schedule; we can automate rotation via the API and integrate with your KMS to store the current key.

Key rotation policy sample (attached key-rotation-sample.json) includes recommended fields: key_id, created_at, rotation_interval_days, last_rotated_at, kms_key_ref. We support HSM-backed keys for Private deployments.

Embedding/reranker scopes: embeddings are a separate scope but we allow the same service account to request both scopes. Quotas are configured per-project; we can scope tokens to only allow embeddings if you want separation.

Docs & links:
- Auth guide: https://docs.redwood.com/integrations/authentication
- Service account API: https://api.redwood.com/docs/service-accounts

I've attached the key rotation sample and a short snippet for the STS exchange. Marissa - happy to join the technical call; Thu morning PT works for me as well.
